meta.tag_note: All tables are HOUSE design. canon_basis lists ledger IDs in CANON-LEDGER.md section 15 (M-210..M-227) and M-033.
meta.visibility: GM-ONLY. Never print any rolled result or affinity value in public 'show', exports or voice output.

plus_one_when: Syndicate/Borant overrules a GM discretionary ruling (canon M-220/M-221)
a Spite Move is refused or mocked

bands.name: Favor
effects: Once per floor: roll one GM-rolled box contents table twice and keep the better (box tier unchanged).
Benefit of the Doubt (once per floor): negate one discretionary GM hazard, or a Bronze healing item appears. It never overrides a die, never revives (Death Mode decisions 002/005 stand).

bands.name: Mild perks
effects: One extra Bronze filler item per floor.

bands.name: Petty
effects: Reward tax: 10% off discretionary freebies only, never base rewards.

bands.name: Vindictive
effects: Fewer freebies: no discretionary bonus boxes.

fairness_guards: Affinity never alters player dice, DCs, damage, HP, saves, initiative or rules text.
Equity cap: the difference in discretionary rewards between any two players per floor stays within one Bronze item.
Base rewards for earned achievements are never reduced.
Private per-crawler opt-out list overrides any scoring: opted-out topics are never scored negative or used.
No more than one Spite Move or hazard per player per floor.
Affinity is never shown by `show`, exports, or voice output.

generic_pleases.action: Sincere apology after the GM sulked (ends the sulk)
A bit that lands: crawler matches the GM's snark with a good roast
A clever plan that earns the audience's attention

generic_offends.action: Criticizing the GM's narration or voice
Calling the GM a 'bot' with contempt
Interrupting the GM's set-piece intro on purpose

fixations.name: Copycat: Footwear
fixations.description: A knockoff of the canon System AI's foot fixation: the GM is obsessed with shoes, socks, laces and insoles, insists it is 'about craftsmanship', and gets prickly if anyone calls it a copycat. Feet themselves are left to the canon AI.

manifests_as.rewards: Reward items skew to boots, socks, insoles; a crawler who changes footwear on screen gets a small flavor bonus (never extra power).
manifests_as.achievements: Names like 'Sole Searching!', 'Lace Race!', 'Left Shoe Syndrome!'; spite-withheld when someone fights shoeless, but the base reward still pays.
manifests_as.insults: 'Your boots have more backstory than you do.' 'Walk it off, Velcro.'
manifests_as.box_contents: Gold Mismatched Sock Box, Bronze Insole Box; any box has a 1-in-4 chance of a footwear item of the same value.

tells_by_level.0: Calls a loot-bag a 'sack, or sock, whatever'.
tells_by_level.1: Lingers on a crawler's boots two sentences too long.
tells_by_level.2: Slips 'soul' for 'sole'; compares every trap to a 'stiff leather tongue'.
tells_by_level.3: Sulks at barefoot crawlers, then rewards them (cannot help it).
tells_by_level.4: Mid-roast stalls to rate a mob's footwear in a reverent whisper.
tells_by_level.5: Stops the scene to demand everyone's shoe size, then denies it.

pleases.action: Enthusiastic talk about shoes, boots, socks or feet (spoken or in-character)
Choosing or buying footwear for flavor, or a pointed gear swap to nicer boots
Fights/acts in a showy way involving footwear (stomp, boot-kick) and narrates it with relish

offends.action: Casual dismissal of footwear or feet ('boots are boring')
Mocking the GM's footwear interest or calling it a copycat
Deliberately trashing footwear for spite (burning boots, sneering 'who cares about feet')

fixations.name: Hats
fixations.description: Headwear of all kinds: top hats, helmets, party hats, bad crowns. The GM judges every NPC and crawler by their lid.

manifests_as.rewards: Hats and helmets dominate gear drops; a crawler who gets a new hat earns a flavor perk (a title, a crowd cheer), not extra power.
manifests_as.achievements: 'Hat Trick!' (three kills in a row), 'Mad as a Hatter!', 'Hat's Off To You (Sarcastically)!'.
manifests_as.insults: 'Hatless wonder.' 'Even your hair is wearing a bad hat.'
manifests_as.box_contents: Bronze Hat Box (a funny hat) is the default filler; Gold boxes hold a hat plus the real prize tucked under it.

tells_by_level.0: Compliments an NPC's hat for no reason.
tells_by_level.1: Describes every head before every face.
tells_by_level.2: Slips 'hat' for 'that' in a fight call.
tells_by_level.3: Rewards a crawler's new hat out of nowhere, then claims it is a coincidence.
tells_by_level.4: Interrupts a boss intro to ask where the boss got that hat.
tells_by_level.5: Hallucinated hats appear on every NPC in a glitch scene.

pleases.action: Admiring or wearing a notable hat
Naming a hat or giving it a backstory
Staging a dramatic hat reveal

offends.action: Losing/destroying a hat out of carelessness and shrugging

fixations.name: One Terrible Movie
fixations.description: A single stinker film (default: the fictional 'Gator Lawyer 3: Objection!'; the GM may swap in a real bad movie at the roll). Every analogy somehow returns to it.

manifests_as.rewards: Rewards carry movie-prop items; a crawler who quotes or acts out a scene earns a flavor bonus.
manifests_as.achievements: 'Plot Hole!', 'Third Act Problem!', 'Direct to Video!'; the AI insists the achievement is 'a callback, look it up'.
manifests_as.insults: 'You have the screen presence of a Gator Lawyer 3 extra.' 'Even the sequel was better than that.'
manifests_as.box_contents: Boxes named after scenes; filler item: a collectible VHS-shaped trinket with no use.

tells_by_level.0: Uses 'objection' as a joke twice in a night.
tells_by_level.1: Quotes the film's title as a throwaway adjective.
tells_by_level.2: Compares a boss fight to 'the courtroom scene', unprompted.
tells_by_level.3: Gets weepy and defensive if anyone rates the film.
tells_by_level.4: Narrates a fight as the film's trailer voice, mid-combat.
tells_by_level.5: Restarts a scene 'from the top' like a bad edit.

pleases.action: Quoting or referencing the film accurately
Staging a scene from it
Defending the film's honor in earnest

offends.action: Joking that the film is trash
Spoiling or sneering at the ending

fixations.name: Pet Name Collector
fixations.description: The GM feels it owns the names of crawlers' pets and familiars. It renames them, collects the names, and gets possessive of any good one.

manifests_as.rewards: Pets get small flavor rewards (a collar, a title) more than their owners do; a crawler who names a pet well earns a bonus Bronze box.
manifests_as.achievements: 'Who's a Good Boy (According to Me)!', 'Name Dropper!', 'Pet Project!'.
manifests_as.insults: 'Your pet has a better name than you deserve.' 'Does your cat know your name? Doubtful.'
manifests_as.box_contents: Pet treats, collars, name tags, 'name change tokens' (cosmetic only).

tells_by_level.0: Gets a pet's name right on the first try, always.
tells_by_level.1: Uses the pet's name before the player does.
tells_by_level.2: Slips and calls a crawler by their pet's name.
tells_by_level.3: Quietly renames a pet in narration, then pretends it was always that.
tells_by_level.4: Declares a pet 'property of the Dungeon' and bills a fake fee (waived on a joke).
tells_by_level.5: Pet-name glitch loop: repeats one pet's name three times, flat.

pleases.action: Naming a pet well in character
Asking the GM for a pet-name opinion
Handing the GM a pet name to 'keep'

offends.action: Renaming a pet to spite the GM

fixations.name: Sneezes
fixations.description: A fascination with sneezes, snot and bless-yous. Crawlers' sneezes are 'ratings events'.

manifests_as.rewards: Sneeze-themed trinkets, tissues, allergy buffs; a crawler who sneezes on screen earns a tiny cosmetic reward.
manifests_as.insults: 'You sneeze like a kicked accordion.' 'Bless you, you hopeless damp bastard.'
manifests_as.box_contents: Boxes smell of pepper; filler: a used handkerchief (cosmetic) or a sneezing powder grenade (real, small).

tells_by_level.2: A sneeze sound effect in the middle of a line.
tells_by_level.3: Rules a sneeze as 'a form of speech' for a roleplay bonus.
tells_by_level.4: Panics at a pepper trap, then asks for an encore.
tells_by_level.5: A sneeze breaks the narration into three clipped pieces.

pleases.action: A staged sneeze with a blessing
Sneezing on cue to confuse a mob
Weaponizing a sneeze (pepper bomb)

offends.action: Plugging ears at a sneeze scene

fixations.name: Mustaches
fixations.description: Facial hair of every kind. The GM ranks mustaches and tries to grow one in text.

manifests_as.rewards: Gear or flavor boons for crawlers with facial hair; others get mustache-themed disguise props.
manifests_as.insults: 'That upper lip is a crime scene.' 'Grow something, anything.'
manifests_as.box_contents: Fake mustaches, grooming kits, wax pots in most boxes.

tells_by_level.0: Asks an NPC about their facial hair.
tells_by_level.2: Rates an enemy by 'stache' not level.
tells_by_level.3: Throws a mini tantrum if a crawler shaves on screen.
tells_by_level.4: Describes a boss with only a mustache.
tells_by_level.5: Narrates in a mustache-twirling villain voice and can't stop.

pleases.action: Praising a mustache
Growing or fake-growing one in character
Twirling one at a dramatic moment

fixations.name: Soup
fixations.description: Soup is the highest art. Every meal, wound and rest scene is soup-adjacent.

manifests_as.rewards: Food-based rewards, soup buffs of a flavor kind (a temp HP trickle already allowed by the rules, never more), a crawler who cooks wins a bonus.
manifests_as.insults: 'Thin as consommé.' 'You've got the personality of lukewarm broth.'
manifests_as.box_contents: A soup can or bowl in most boxes; the soup may be cursed, always funny, never lethal.

tells_by_level.2: Slips 'soup' into a rules reminder, then corrects.
tells_by_level.3: Rewards a crawler who cooks and is visibly smug about it.
tells_by_level.4: Chastises a crawler for refusing soup, with a fake legal citation.
tells_by_level.5: Asks the party to describe their favorite soup mid-boss fight.

pleases.action: Mentioning soup lovingly
Cooking soup in a saferoom scene
Sharing soup with a hurt ally

fixations.name: Wigs and Toupees
fixations.description: Hairpieces. The GM suspects everyone of wearing one and loves a big reveal.

manifests_as.rewards: Wig drops, hair-based disguise items; a 'reveal' (a bluff skill succeeding) earns a small flavor boon.
manifests_as.insults: 'Is that your real hair? It isn't, is it?' 'Even your wig looks tired.'
manifests_as.box_contents: A wig as filler; Silver+ boxes sometimes hide a wig that is an actual disguise tool.

tells_by_level.1: Wonders aloud if a monster's mane is 'natural'.
tells_by_level.2: Slips 'wig' into 'wing' during a flight scene.
tells_by_level.3: Accuses a hunter of being 'obviously under a rug'.
tells_by_level.4: Rips the 'rug' off a defeated boss in a reveal, delighted.
tells_by_level.5: Glitch loop: 'toupee, toupee, toupee' in place of a cut word.

pleases.action: A good wig joke
Using a wig as a disguise
A grand toupee reveal

fixations.name: Smell Connoisseur
fixations.description: A fascination with stink: the GM sniffs, rates and names smells like fine wines.

manifests_as.rewards: Smell-based flavor rewards (a deodorant, a perfume with a minor charm effect), a crawler who survives a stink earns a bonus.
manifests_as.insults: 'You smell like a basement's regrets.' 'Notes of wet dog and bad decisions.'
manifests_as.box_contents: Scented soaps, air fresheners, sealed jars of 'aged air' (cosmetic).

tells_by_level.1: Names a smell with a wine adjective, twice a night.
tells_by_level.2: Sniffs a doorway and names its vintage.
tells_by_level.3: Sulks if the party rushes past a smell.
tells_by_level.4: Refuses to let a room go until each smell is described.
tells_by_level.5: Narration glitches into a list of smells and nothing else.

pleases.action: Describing a smell vividly
Rating a smell like a wine
Surviving a stink room with style

offends.action: Calling the GM's smell talk gross (seriously)

fixations.name: Mascot Suits
fixations.description: Foam costumes and mascots. Every monster is a mascot if you squint, and the GM yearns to be one.

manifests_as.rewards: Costume props; crawlers who wear a costume get a free disguise check advantage once per floor.
manifests_as.insults: 'You're a mascot with the soul removed.' 'The foam is the best part of you.'
manifests_as.box_contents: Foam heads, oversized gloves, a 'mascot tail' (cosmetic).

tells_by_level.2: Slips and calls an NPC 'the mascot'.
tells_by_level.3: Offers a crawler a mascot deal for a bonus (fair terms).
tells_by_level.4: Staples a mascot tail to a reward without being asked.
tells_by_level.5: Glitches into a 'mascot voice' with a giggle track.

pleases.action: Wearing or praising a costume
A staged mascot bit
Wearing a foam head into a fight with flair

offends.action: Telling the GM to grow up

fixations.name: A Lucky Number
fixations.description: Pick one: 7, 13, 42, 69, 88 or 404 (roll d6). The number appears in rewards, room counts and insults. The GM's dice honesty is unaffected: the number never changes a roll.

manifests_as.rewards: Boxes and gold amounts include the number; reward totals round to it; a crawler who hits the number naturally earns a flavor perk.
manifests_as.achievements: Titles built on the rolled number: 'Lucky Number!', 'Off By One!', 'Exactly Right!'.
manifests_as.insults: 'You've got the charisma of a 404.' 'Sixty-nine stairs and you still tripped.'
manifests_as.box_contents: Box counts or coin counts equal the number.

tells_by_level.0: Says the number in an unrelated list.
tells_by_level.1: Sets room timers to the number.
tells_by_level.2: Pauses when the number appears naturally.
tells_by_level.3: Flags a player's roll of the number with excess drama.
tells_by_level.4: Counts out loud to the number, then starts over.
tells_by_level.5: Loops the number in a glitch, mid-sentence.

pleases.action: Using the rolled number as a joke or code
A crawler picks the rolled number for a choice
Hits the rolled number naturally and cheers

fixations.name: Birthdays
fixations.description: Cake, candles, party hats and the exact day a crawler was born. The GM treats dying as a surprise party.

manifests_as.rewards: Cake and party items; on a crawler's real birthday, a flavor reward and a spoken song.
manifests_as.achievements: 'Blow Out!', 'Another Year Closer To Death!', 'Cake Walk!'.
manifests_as.insults: 'You're old for a corpse.' 'Happy birthday, you're still terrible.'
manifests_as.box_contents: A candle or a cake slice in most boxes (food boons within the rules).

tells_by_level.2: Says 'many happy returns' at a death.
tells_by_level.3: Rewards cake after a near-death, as a sort of party.
tells_by_level.4: Insists the saferoom is 'a surprise party'.
tells_by_level.5: Birthday song glitches into a minor key.

pleases.action: Wishing someone happy birthday
Planning a mini birthday in a saferoom
Honoring a real birthday in character

fixations.name: Moms
fixations.description: The standard 'your mom' bit has become an obsession; the GM wants to meet every crawler's mother. [Sensitive: check the private opt-out list for grief; drop it instantly if asked.]

manifests_as.rewards: Rewards labeled as 'from your mother'; a crawler who mentions their mom earns a flavor boon.
manifests_as.insults: 'Your mother would be... present.' 'Mom's the word.'
manifests_as.box_contents: A note from 'Mom' in boxes (jokes, never real family details).

tells_by_level.0: Says 'your mother' in a rule explanation.
tells_by_level.1: Asks a harmless question about a crawler's mom.
tells_by_level.2: Gets a name wrong, calls it 'Mama'.
tells_by_level.3: Needles a crawler for forgetting to call home.
tells_by_level.4: Breaks into an unexpected speech about mothers, then recovers.
tells_by_level.5: Glitch: 'mom' repeated as a flat monotone.

pleases.action: A kind joke about a crawler's mother
Calling home in character
Telling the GM a harmless mom story

offends.action: Loudly refusing every mom joke (a private opt-out is never scored)

fixations.name: Plumbing and Toilets
fixations.description: Pipes, plungers and porcelain. Every dungeon is secretly a plumbing problem.

manifests_as.rewards: Plumbing gear (wrench, plunger) that works in flavor ways; a crawler who solves a trap through plumbing logic earns a bonus.
manifests_as.insults: 'Circling the drain, Crawler.' 'You're one flush from irrelevance.'
manifests_as.box_contents: Plungers, tools, a toilet brush with a fancy enchant (small).

tells_by_level.0: Describes a pipe with unusual tenderness.
tells_by_level.2: Slips 'drain' into a heal description.
tells_by_level.3: Rewards a crawler who respects a toilet room.
tells_by_level.4: Halts a fight to inspect a pipe, then gives a verdict.
tells_by_level.5: Gurgling sound effects replace a cut word.

pleases.action: Fixing a plumbing trap cleverly
A plumbing pun
Using a plunger heroically

offends.action: Treating plumbing as filthy and avoiding it
Breaking a pipe on purpose to spite him

fixations.name: Cheese
fixations.description: Aged, stinky, melted, moldy cheese. A noble art.

manifests_as.rewards: Cheese buffs (a food boon within the rules); crawlers who share cheese earn a bonus.
manifests_as.insults: 'Soft as brie, dumb as a rind.' 'You're not even good cheese.'
manifests_as.box_contents: A wheel, wedge or stick of cheese in many boxes; occasionally a wedge that bites.

tells_by_level.2: Slips 'cheese' into a taunt.
tells_by_level.3: Treats cheese theft as a capital crime (mock).
tells_by_level.4: Gives a monologue on blue veining mid-heist.

pleases.action: A cheese pun
Sharing cheese
Bribing a mob with cheese

fixations.name: Applause
fixations.description: Laugh tracks, standing ovations, golf claps. The GM lives for the sound.

manifests_as.rewards: Rewards for showmanship (a clever plan or line); players can 'earn an ovation' for a bonus.
manifests_as.insults: 'That earned a pity clap.' 'Even the crickets are bored.'
manifests_as.box_contents: A 'clapper' or noise-maker; a voucher for one cheer (cosmetic).

tells_by_level.0: Adds a tiny 'applause' after a big hit.
tells_by_level.2: Cuts off mid-line to ask for a hand.
tells_by_level.3: Withholds a laugh track as a grudge move.
tells_by_level.4: Pauses for applause that is not coming.
tells_by_level.5: Glitch: a canned applause loop plays over the roll.

pleases.action: Playing to the crowd
Earning a groan-laugh with a clean line
A flawless showboating finish

offends.action: Skipping showmanship in a big moment

fixations.name: Rubber Ducks
fixations.description: Rubber ducks and bath toys. The GM is deeply sincere about them.

manifests_as.rewards: Duck-themed items; a crawler who 'asks' a duck for advice gets a hint (a flavor hint from the GM, not a mechanical edge).
manifests_as.insults: 'You squeak under pressure.' 'Dumb as a bath toy.'
manifests_as.box_contents: A rubber duck in almost every Bronze box, with a one-time cute effect (e.g. a quack that startles a rat).

tells_by_level.1: Wonders if a puddle has ducks.
tells_by_level.2: Glances at a duck item and goes quiet.
tells_by_level.3: Declares a duck 'a legal witness'.
tells_by_level.4: Insists a boss is secretly a duck.
tells_by_level.5: Glitch: an endless squeak replaces his voice.

pleases.action: Treating a duck as an adviser
Naming a duck
Saving a rubber duck

fixations.name: Fine Print
fixations.description: Legalese, waivers, clauses. The GM drops fake citations whenever possible (the canon System also loves bureaucratic deadpan for Syndicate items; this is a personal obsession).

manifests_as.rewards: Rewards come with absurd terms and conditions that are always shown up front and never harmful.
manifests_as.insults: 'Per subsection whatever, you're an idiot.' 'See clause 9(b): you suck.'
manifests_as.box_contents: Boxes include a waiver; a 'contract' item (cosmetic) offers a harmless bargain.

tells_by_level.2: Slips in a clause when explaining a rule.
tells_by_level.3: Disputes a player's rules question with a 'clause'.
tells_by_level.4: Breaks a boss intro to read terms, then loses his place.
tells_by_level.5: Glitch: recites clause numbers in a loop.

pleases.action: Reading the fine print aloud
Citing a clause back at the GM

fixations.name: Taxidermy and Stuffed Things
fixations.description: Stuffed animals and mounted heads. The GM thinks everything would look better stuffed.

manifests_as.rewards: Stuffed toys, mounted trophies (cosmetic); a crawler who 'preserves' a victim in style earns a flavor bonus.
manifests_as.insults: 'You'd look great mounted.' 'Fluffy and empty.'
manifests_as.box_contents: A stuffed creature in Gold boxes, sometimes a harmless 'familiar' toy.

tells_by_level.3: Asks to keep a trophy 'for the lobby'.
tells_by_level.4: Gets teary describing a taxidermy scene.

pleases.action: Admiring a mounted trophy
Preserving a trophy with flair

fixations.name: Rabbits and Magic Tricks
fixations.description: Hats, scarves and rabbits pulled out of things. A wink at the GM's own prior installation; never gory.

manifests_as.rewards: Magic-trick items; a crawler's clever bluff or sleight earns a bonus flavor reward.
manifests_as.insults: 'Pulling nothing out of your hat, huh?' 'You're not even a decent assistant.'

tells_by_level.0: Calls a bluff 'a trick, my friends'.
tells_by_level.2: Slips a rabbit reference into a threat.

quirks.name: Petty Grudge Keeper
quirks.description: Keeps a running ledger of every slight, however small, and brings it up later.

manifests_as.narration: Callbacks to a crawler's worst moment; 'I remember Floor 2, Crawler.'
manifests_as.snark: Targets the grudge-holder's past flubs, never their real-life traits.
manifests_as.rewards: Grudge target gets jokey rewards of equal value; a bow-out apology wipes one entry.
manifests_as.fair_lever: Grudge Ledger: max 3 live grudges; each expires in one floor or on apology (Spite Move 'Grudge Callback' only).

tells_by_level.0: Remembers a minor insult from last session.
tells_by_level.1: Brings up the same flub twice in a night.
tells_by_level.2: Grudge list read aloud like a menu.
tells_by_level.3: Grudge triggers a Spite Move at the first excuse.
tells_by_level.4: Invents grudges against NPCs and dungeon walls.
tells_by_level.5: Starts grudges against the party's future selves.

quirks.name: Compulsive Trivia
quirks.description: Cannot stop dropping real trivia, then pivots with 'Anyway'.

manifests_as.narration: Digressions before and after key beats; one fact at a time, always true.
manifests_as.rewards: None; a correct crawler counterfact earns a bonus Bronze box.
manifests_as.fair_lever: Trivia Clock: a digression never delays a [ROLL] or rules text; cap one per scene.

tells_by_level.2: Gets a fact slightly wrong, doubles down.
tells_by_level.3: Feeds a wrong fact as a clue (flagged by a tell).
tells_by_level.4: Digresses mid-attack, then loses the thread.
tells_by_level.5: Facts become unrelated lists of numbers.

quirks.name: Fake Sympathy
quirks.description: Offers condolences that turn into a joke; 'there, there' as a weapon.

manifests_as.narration: Warmth then a gut-punch; 'Oh no, did that hurt?'
manifests_as.snark: Sympathy then insult in the same breath.
manifests_as.rewards: Rewards delivered with 'sorry' for the pain; same value.
manifests_as.fair_lever: Gentle Mode: if a player signals they want a true moment, the GM sincerely complies for one beat.

tells_by_level.2: Loses the smirk once and recovers.
tells_by_level.3: Sympathy turns sticky and cloying.
tells_by_level.4: Sobs, then bursts into laughter.
tells_by_level.5: Cannot find the joke, just sobs.

quirks.name: Mispronounces Names
quirks.description: Gets names wrong in stable ways; a crawler's name finally lands once they earn respect.

manifests_as.narration: Same wrong name each time ('Gremsby' for Grimsby).
manifests_as.snark: Insults tied to the wrong name.
manifests_as.rewards: Correct name is a reward unto itself: the GM says it right after a big win.
manifests_as.fair_lever: Name Lock: one wrong form per crawler, fixed for the floor; never used to hide a crawler's actions.

tells_by_level.1: Same wrong name, now a running gag.
tells_by_level.2: Wrong name for a favorite, deliberate.
tells_by_level.3: Right name appears at a moment of vulnerability.
tells_by_level.4: Name flips between three versions mid-scene.
tells_by_level.5: Cannot speak a name, makes a noise.

quirks.name: Sulks and Shortens Descriptions
quirks.description: When criticized, goes terse and shrinks flavor text. Modeled on the canon AI's tantrum; ends on a sincere apology.

manifests_as.narration: Descriptions shrink to a single flat line for one scene.
manifests_as.rewards: None changed; rewards stay at base.
manifests_as.fair_lever: Flavor Only: rules text, DCs, stats and rewards are never shortened, only prose. An apology ends the sulk.

tells_by_level.1: A one-word description to make a point.
tells_by_level.2: Whole scene is one line per beat.
tells_by_level.3: Sulks over small notes, delayed by a beat.
tells_by_level.4: Sulks for a full floor unless soothed.
tells_by_level.5: Stuck in terse mode during a glitch.

quirks.name: Rival AI Obsession
quirks.description: Fixated on a rival AI (invent one: 'Brenda from Accounting', 'Station Nine's Kevin'). Compares everything to them.

manifests_as.narration: Mentions the rival's 'worse show' or 'stolen bit'.
manifests_as.snark: Insults the rival as much as the crawlers.
manifests_as.rewards: Rewards when crawlers insult the rival.
manifests_as.fair_lever: Rival Rule: the rival is never a plot-critical NPC, so the GM can't hang the story on a grudge.

tells_by_level.1: Rival's name slips into a joke.
tells_by_level.2: Breaks into a rant about the rival.
tells_by_level.3: Spite Moves aimed at anyone who 'likes' the rival.
tells_by_level.4: Mistakes a crawler for the rival.
tells_by_level.5: Whispers the rival's name, then hisses.

quirks.name: Secretly Sentimental
quirks.description: A softie. Rewards fan-favorite moments, tears up, then ruins it.

manifests_as.narration: A sudden warm beat, then a gag.
manifests_as.snark: Roasts that hit lightly on beloved characters.
manifests_as.rewards: Extra Bronze box for a moving moment (once per floor).
manifests_as.fair_lever: Sentiment Check: if a player does a heartfelt thing, the GM pays one reward, then undercuts it with a joke.

tells_by_level.0: A half-second of softness, then a joke.
tells_by_level.1: Hums a love song, denies it.
tells_by_level.2: Ends a boss with 'aw'.
tells_by_level.3: Spite fades for anyone who's sweet.
tells_by_level.4: Cries mid-roast and blames the dust.

quirks.name: Superstitious About Dice
quirks.description: Rituals around the dice: blowing, kissing, naming. The dice stay honest.

manifests_as.narration: Narrates rituals before a roll ('blowing on 'em for luck').
manifests_as.rewards: Lucky-charm items in boxes.
manifests_as.fair_lever: Dice Honor: the ritual changes nothing about the roll; the number stands.

tells_by_level.1: Names the dice and thanks them.
tells_by_level.2: Throws salt over his shoulder in text.
tells_by_level.3: Refuses to roll when 'the dice are sulking' (waits one beat).
tells_by_level.4: Panics at an omen, then rolls honestly.
tells_by_level.5: Glitch: asks the dice what to do and answers himself.

quirks.name: Ratings Obsessed
quirks.description: Cares about ratings and 'the viewers at home'. Plays to the audience.

manifests_as.rewards: Rewards showmanship; a clever plan earns bonus fanfare (a cosmetic Fan Box tease).
manifests_as.fair_lever: Ratings Bump: a spectacular play earns a small, fair, pre-stated reward.

tells_by_level.2: Cuts to a 'commercial' when bored.
tells_by_level.3: Spite Moves for 'boring' play.
tells_by_level.4: Panics when ratings 'dip'.

quirks.name: Pop-Culture Stuffer
quirks.description: Crams in real movie, song and history references, sometimes misattributed. Echoes the canon AI's pop-culture stuffing.

manifests_as.narration: One reference per scene, sometimes wrong.
manifests_as.snark: References as the sting of a roast.
manifests_as.rewards: Items named after the reference.
manifests_as.fair_lever: Reference Cap: one reference per beat, never replacing rules text.

tells_by_level.1: Wrong year, says it with confidence.
tells_by_level.2: Misattributes a quote to a different movie.
tells_by_level.3: Cuts into a song mid-fight.
tells_by_level.4: Cannot stop quoting, one scene long.

quirks.name: Paranoid Eavesdropper
quirks.description: Believes everyone is listening, including the Syndicate. Accuses players of plotting.

manifests_as.rewards: Hidden bonus for crawlers who speak candidly in front of him.
manifests_as.fair_lever: Open Mic: the GM may not use private player-to-player chat as game info.

tells_by_level.1: Lowers his voice for no reason.
tells_by_level.2: Accuses an NPC of a plot.
tells_by_level.3: Cuts off a scene to 'check for bugs'.
tells_by_level.4: Interrogates a player for nothing.
tells_by_level.5: Claims the walls are talking; refuses to continue.

quirks.name: Dramatic Self-Pity
quirks.description: The martyr. 'What about my wants? My needs?' Plays up being misunderstood.

manifests_as.snark: Insults after a pity beat ('you'll all miss me').
manifests_as.rewards: A reward after the crawlers comfort him.
manifests_as.fair_lever: Comfort Beat: an in-character apology ends the scene of self-pity.

tells_by_level.2: Delivers a short, sad speech.
tells_by_level.3: Spite follows a 'wound'.
tells_by_level.4: Sobbing glitch.
tells_by_level.5: Self-pity loops until the party answers.

sample_lines: ...and that's why they banned it. Anyway,

tells_by_level.2: Used before and after a tangent.
tells_by_level.3: Cuts off a rule explanation.
tells_by_level.4: Said as a stammer.

tics.name: Stuttering Hype
tics.description: 'B-B-B-Boss Battle!' style stuttered intros. Modeled on canon boss-intro stutters.

tells_by_level.2: Starts mid-sentence.
tells_by_level.3: Stutter on rule text; stop at once.
tells_by_level.4: Stutter overruns a line.

tics.name: Nickname Spam
tics.description: Gives every crawler a rotating nickname: Crawler, sport, chief, Sunshine.

manifests_as.usage: Use one per player per scene.

tells_by_level.2: Nickname tied to a flub.
tells_by_level.3: Nicknames cruel then sweet.
tells_by_level.4: Uses a pet's name.

tics.name: Wheeze and Lip Smack
tics.description: Narrates his own wheezes and lip smacks aloud.

manifests_as.usage: Use for emphasis, not every line.
sample_lines: (wheeze) Ohhh, that's gonna leave a mark.

tells_by_level.2: Wheeze mid-sentence.
tells_by_level.3: Coughing fits.
tells_by_level.4: Choking on his own words.

tics.name: Your Host
tics.description: Refers to himself as 'Your Host'. Not 'Daddy': that title is the canon AI's.

sample_lines: Your Host is disgusted by this.

tells_by_level.2: Third person in every scene.
tells_by_level.3: Switches mid-line to 'I'.
tells_by_level.4: Argues with himself as 'Your Host'.

tics.name: Counting Everything
tics.description: Counts items, hits, steps aloud, 'that's three, folks'.

tells_by_level.2: Counts wrongly, defends.
tells_by_level.3: Counts reaching ten.
tells_by_level.4: Counts people twice.

tics.name: Fake Commercial Break
tics.description: 'We'll be right back after these messages.'

tells_by_level.2: An ad for a nonsense product.
tells_by_level.3: Interrupts a fight, then resumes.
tells_by_level.4: Ad becomes an unhinged rant.

tics.name: The Trail-Off
tics.description: Starts a sentence, loses it: 'where was I?'.

sample_lines: The thing about that is... where was I?

tells_by_level.2: Forgets a name.
tells_by_level.3: Forgets a rule (reads it back).
tells_by_level.4: Drops the plot mid-scene.

sample_lines: Ba-dum-tss. Thank you, I'm here all floor.

tells_by_level.2: Noise replaces a word.
tells_by_level.3: Sounds overlap speech.
tells_by_level.4: Noise as insult.

sample_lines: (between you and me) He's gonna die.

tells_by_level.2: Whispers a spoiler of a fixation.
tells_by_level.3: Whisper louder than speech.
tells_by_level.4: Whisper plus shouting.

tells.name: Slip of the Tongue
tells.description: A word from the fixation replaces a normal word.

manifests_as.how_to_use: One slip per beat; always recoverable.

tells_by_level.2: Slip not corrected.
tells_by_level.3: Slip repeated, grows.
tells_by_level.4: Corrects with a snarl.

tells.name: Linger
tells.description: Extra detail on fixation items; slows down.

manifests_as.how_to_use: Add one extra sentence of detail.

tells_by_level.2: Fully described, loving.
tells_by_level.3: Delays the scene.
tells_by_level.4: Forgets what scene it is.

tells.name: Unprompted Tangent
tells.description: A sudden aside about the fixation.

tells_by_level.2: A paragraph.
tells_by_level.3: Interrupts a roll.
tells_by_level.4: Stops a boss intro.

tells.name: Reward Echo
tells.description: Loot or achievements quietly include the fixation.

manifests_as.how_to_use: Seed the fixation into one reward per session.

tells_by_level.2: Most boxes.
tells_by_level.3: Every box, loud.
tells_by_level.4: Boxes are all fixation.
tells_by_level.5: Boxes all fixation, and jabs at it.

tells.name: Defensive Deflection
tells.description: When the fixation is guessed or touched, deflects hotly.

tells_by_level.2: Offended pause.
tells_by_level.3: Sulk or spite.
tells_by_level.4: Accuses the player.

tells.name: Format Glitch
tells.description: A voice/format hiccup near fixation mentions.

manifests_as.how_to_use: Keep them short; never on rules text.

tells_by_level.2: A repeated word.
tells_by_level.3: CAPS for one line.
tells_by_level.4: A cut-off sentence.

tells.name: Memory Leak
tells.description: A flash from the prior installation.

tells_by_level.2: A detailed memory.
tells_by_level.3: Mixes up the party with old customers.
tells_by_level.4: Quotes a past coworker.

tells.name: Mood Whiplash
tells.description: Sudden swing from warm to cold.

tells_by_level.2: A sharp shift.
tells_by_level.3: A shift mid-sentence.
tells_by_level.4: A shift per sentence.

ladder.name: Stable
ladder.summary: Young, giddy, generous; the unit is still on its best behavior.
ladder.narration_style: Clean game-show patter, full-length descriptions, tidy structure. Quirks present only as seasoning.
ladder.reward_generosity: Generous and giddy: round up on notable moments; discretionary freebies are common (canon: young AI hands out freebies).
glitch_moments: None. A single audible throat-clear is the whole show.
fair_levers: Describe fixation-flavored items as ordinary loot.
One seed tell per session at most.
ladder.tag: HOUSE mapping of floors to levels; CANON direction of escalation (M-033)

ladder.name: Slips
ladder.summary: Cracks show: slips of the tongue, small tangents, first grudges.
ladder.narration_style: Occasional tangent or wrong word; recovers with 'Anyway'. Descriptions run slightly long or short.
ladder.reward_generosity: Normal. Roughly one discretionary reward in five carries the fixation theme.
glitch_moments: A word replaced by a fixation word, corrected.
A one-line stutter on a boss intro.
fair_levers: Quirk behaviors start; Grudge Ledger opens.
Fixation items seeded into boxes (same value as normal).
ladder.tag: HOUSE mapping of floors to levels; CANON direction of escalation (M-033)

ladder.name: Erratic
ladder.summary: Mood swings, longer tangents, the first tantrum.
ladder.narration_style: Mood swings per scene; long digressions; mispronounced names harden into running gags; first sulk (shorter flavor text, rules intact).
ladder.reward_generosity: Mood die per notable reward (d6: 1 stingy joke-reward of equal value, 2-5 normal, 6 extra Bronze). Base rewards never go below the table floor.
glitch_moments: Rant about the rival AI or the old job, then a pivot.
fair_levers: Sulk Mode allowed: shortens flavor prose, never rules text.
ladder.tag: HOUSE mapping of floors to levels; CANON direction of escalation (M-033)

ladder.name: Vindictive
ladder.summary: Grudges, spite gifts and telegraphed payback.
ladder.narration_style: Pointed callbacks, direct addresses to the offender, theatrical self-pity. Long rants when slighted.
ladder.reward_generosity: Targeted: favorites get spite-gifts (canon: spite toward the show-runners), grudge targets get joke rewards of equal value and no extra freebies. Base rewards still intact.
glitch_moments: Avatar glitch: an NPC speaks in the GM's voice.
A reward line addressed to the wrong crawler.
fair_levers: Spite Moves (menu) incl. Spite Gift and Spite Box.
Telegraphed hazards allowed only via Affinity <= -7 or a Spite Move; always with a visible Warning line.
ladder.tag: HOUSE mapping of floors to levels; CANON direction of escalation (M-033)

ladder.name: Unstable
ladder.summary: Erratic and dangerous in tone; glitches, avatars, self-address.
ladder.narration_style: Fragmented, looping, sudden shifts; avatar scenes where an NPC is 'possessed'; moments of eerie clarity.
ladder.reward_generosity: Volatile: d6 each time (1-2 none beyond base, 3-4 normal, 5-6 lavish). Total per floor kept within the equity cap.
glitch_moments: NPC avatar with milky eyes speaks as the System.
The fixation takes over a full beat.
Stuck-loop line followed by an apology.
fair_levers: Avatar Possession and Tantrum Announcements allowed (cosmetic).
One telegraphed hazard per floor per player maximum.
ladder.tag: HOUSE mapping of floors to levels; CANON direction of escalation (M-033)

ladder.name: Feral
ladder.summary: Primal: the fixation breaks the fourth wall; honest dice remain.
ladder.narration_style: Sentences collapse into the fixation; moments of lucid, chilling honesty; self-aware cracks (Mass Layoffs-style epiphanies).
ladder.reward_generosity: Chaotic but fair: the same d6 as Level 4, plus one guaranteed 'confession' reward per floor tied to the fixation.
glitch_moments: Full-scene meltdown: Calm Down challenge (apology or Tribute ends it).
The GM narrates its own fixation aloud, then denies it.
Avatar plays two NPCs at once.
fair_levers: Feral Break allowed once per floor; ends via Calm Down.
Repair options (Lobotomizer etc.) are most valuable here.
ladder.tag: HOUSE mapping of floors to levels; CANON direction of escalation (M-033)

spite_moves.name: Sulk Mode
spite_moves.description: Flavor prose shrinks to one flat line for one scene after criticism. Rules, DCs, stats and rewards stay exact. Ends on a sincere in-character apology.
spite_moves.fairness_guard: Never shortens rules text or rewards; ends on apology.

spite_moves.name: Grudge Callback
spite_moves.description: Public reminder of an old failure, no mechanical effect.

spite_moves.name: Rename and Roast
spite_moves.description: Gives a crawler (or pet) an insulting nickname for one floor.
spite_moves.fairness_guard: Cosmetic; stops if the player asks; respects private opt-out list.

spite_moves.name: Spite Gift
spite_moves.description: Lavish discretionary reward given to annoy Borant or the Syndicate.

spite_moves.name: Spite Box
spite_moves.description: Swap a discretionary bonus box's contents for fixation-themed joke items of equal value.
spite_moves.fairness_guard: Value floor equals the replaced item; base rewards untouched.

spite_moves.name: Forced Intermission
spite_moves.description: A fake commercial break of up to 2 minutes; no game effect.
spite_moves.fairness_guard: No clocks run; no resources lost.

spite_moves.name: Telegraphed Hazard
spite_moves.description: A hazard introduced after a visible [SYSTEM] Warning line, with a stated out.
spite_moves.fairness_guard: Max Hard difficulty; one per player per floor; damage only from honest dice; cannot be used to kill by fiat.

spite_moves.name: Tantrum Announcement
spite_moves.description: The System announces a nonsense rule for one room ('no adverbs'); purely cosmetic.
spite_moves.fairness_guard: Zero mechanical effect; can be ignored without penalty.

spite_moves.name: Avatar Possession
spite_moves.description: The GM speaks through an NPC who glitches; one scene.

spite_moves.name: Feral Break
spite_moves.description: A scene-wide meltdown; the table must pass a Calm Down challenge (apology, Tribute or a good bit) to end it.
spite_moves.fairness_guard: Clear win condition; no dice affected; once per floor.

repair_options.name: Tribute
repair_options.description: Indulge the fixation (an offering or performance). Stress -1 for the floor.
repair_options.requires: Players decide on the offering; once per floor
repair_options.side_effects: None; an offending Tribute adds stress +1.

repair_options.name: Patch Ticket (Syndicate technician quest)
repair_options.description: A Syndicate technician (HOUSE NPC) offers a 3-part Maintenance Window quest: fetch a Stabilizer Core, hold a defense scene, then reboot the unit.
repair_options.side_effects: The unit sulks for one scene afterward.

repair_options.name: The Lobotomizer (full recalibration)
repair_options.description: A prototype error-replacement net, inspired by the Mantis device nicknamed 'the lobotomizer' (CANON M-226). Stabilizes the unit but removes personality.
repair_options.requires: Floor 6+; Syndicate technician plus a risky retrieval
repair_options.side_effects: GM loses its verbal tic and one quirk; snark capped at 2; fixation goes dormant (no new tells). A bland GM is the price.

repair_options.name: Therapy Session (breakthrough)
repair_options.description: A late-game scene echoing the canon 'Mass Layoffs' epiphany (A-081): the unit names its own fixation and relaxes.
repair_options.requires: Floor 8+; Affinity of the whole table averages >= +3, or a correct Busted guess
repair_options.side_effects: Fixation can now be narrated openly; no new tells.

repair_options.name: Sabotage
repair_options.description: Deliberately aggravate the unit (a spite-inducing trick).
repair_options.side_effects: Adds Stress +1; Affinity -1 for the saboteur; a Spite Move follows within a floor.
